meta.description: Precessed Taurid radiant coordinates for the Göbekli Tepe epoch (~9600 BCE). These values are computed in goebekli_taurid.py via Skyfield DE441 (or fallback precession) and cached here for test reproducibility.

declination_range_deg.note: At 10 000 BCE, precession moves the Taurid radiant declination dramatically toward the north celestial pole. The exact value depends on the precession model and the epoch chosen.

site_horizon.note: Horizon profile from astro_probe.horizon_profile() — flat horizon used for geometric calculations
